products_or_services: Custom celebration cakes (birthdays, engagements, weddings, corporate events)
Signature cakes: Chocolate Fudge Overload, Classic Red Velvet, Lotus Biscoff Dream, Belgian Chocolate Truffle
Mini desserts & cupcake boxes for gifting
Bento cakes -- minimalist, trendy small cakes for personal celebrations

target_audience.demographics: Women aged 18-40 in Karachi (DHA, Clifton, Gulshan, Bahria Town) buying for birthdays, engagements, weddings, and personal indulgence.
target_audience.psychographics: Active on Instagram, values aesthetics and quality, willing to pay a premium for custom design and balanced (not overly sweet) flavor.
pain_points: Hard to find bakeries that balance beautiful design with genuinely good flavor
Generic, mass-produced cakes for special occasions
Slow or unreliable delivery for time-sensitive events

competitors_or_market: Local home bakeries and dessert shops in Karachi
unique_value_proposition: Premium ingredients, balanced sweetness, full custom design flexibility, and reliable on-time delivery -- the personal touch of a home bakery with the consistency of a professional one.
additional_context: Orders placed 2-3 days in advance, 50% advance payment required to confirm, delivery via rider service (Careem/Bykea) to DHA, Clifton, Gulshan, Bahria Town.
